### Set Up

```{r}
# Read in packages
library(dplyr)


# Read in data
willowdat <- read.csv("REU project test data - Sheet1.csv") %>%
  select(-region) %>% #remove from final addition
```


## Data Wrangling
```{r}
# clean/filter raster precip/elevation data

# clean/filter willow data
willowdat_clean <- willowdat %>%
  
  mutate(region = as.factor(case_when(
    site %in% c("SAGW", "HAPP") ~ "NOBRO",
    site %in% c("GALB") ~ "CEBRO",
    site %in% c("CLAR", "DOUG") ~ "SOBRO"))) %>%
  
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(thaw_depth = mean(thaw_depth_W_base, thaw_depth_E_base))


willowdat_averages <- willowdat_clean %>%
  mutate(
    thaw_avg_2025 = (col1_2025 + col2_2025) / 2,
    avg_2026 = (col1_2026 + col2_2026) / 2
  )
```
